prompt_fragment: This asset is a sprite. Keep the silhouette clean and readable, with one clear focal subject and strong separation from the background.
raw_description:
A Wake-Singer cruising at the surface in dark polar water, seen from
directly above. The water around her visibly distorts from invoked
pressure-magic. A ring of copper-smelling warm current (the Corpse
Current) rippling outward from the figure. Ominous civilizational scale
— a shaman-warrior, not a beast.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor plate on aged parchment, adult orca wake-singer viewed from directly above cruising at the surface, polar water rendered in deep slate and abyssal ink with ember-copper Corpse Current rippling outward in concentric rings.

subjects.description: Massive sleek adult orca, blue-black hide, ivory hunt-liturgy scar-lines crossing the snout, carved resonance-chambers visible in the flanks, upright dorsal fin with lashed bone relic, salt-crust texture along skin edges, civilizational gravity in posture
subjects.position: centered, full body, aerial top-down view

subjects.description: Dense gravitational haze radiating outward from the orca's flanks, watercolor wash warping in concentric arcs, subsonic weight rendered as compressed ripple-rings pressing outward across the surface plane
Warm copper-ember current blooming outward from the orca in loose organic rings, mottled amber-rust wash bleeding into cold slate water, salt-foam at the edges
